prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: loose homepage sketch to isolate afterward
Input images: Image 1 supplies only the table-and-cup motif and approximate placement; Image 2 is the approved window drawing and is the sole authority for looseness, sparse density, weak line quality, and messy annotation style
Primary request: redraw the table and cup much less cleanly, as a tiny uncertain notebook scribble—not a furniture illustration
Subject: retain only an awkward tabletop outline, three imperfect leg marks, one lopsided cup, a faint cup ring, and one crossed-out false-start leg
Style/medium: match Image 2 closely; faint graphite and weak ballpoint, broken contours, false starts, doubled and abandoned marks, awkward perspective, visibly unskilled but observant
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2; object only in the central third; at least two thirds of canvas visually empty
Annotations: replace every readable word with three tiny clusters of barely decipherable private shorthand—overlapping letters, scratched-out fragments, inconsistent scale and baseline; notes never intended for another person to read; add one weak crooked arrow and a rough partial circle
Background: completely flat pure white, opaque, featureless; no transparency checkerboard and no texture
Constraints: under twenty-five principal strokes; no shading, no wood rendering, no clean continuous edge
Avoid: legible sentences, neat handwriting, font-like letters, calligraphy, polished furniture drawing, accurate geometry, symmetry, clean perspective, paper grain, checkerboard, gray background, shadow, border, watermark

Post-processing: the flat generated background was converted to real alpha transparency; generated linework, notes, and composition otherwise preserved.
